fidelity_description: L0 two-body orbit (planets/SRP omitted: 0.02 % on P_grid at 1 au, M7b/M8 re-evaluation), day-incommensurate 3896 s grid, batched Airy capture (numpy_batch), ERA5 total cloud cover at the receiver (threshold 0.5, nearest node; the weather year is an aleatory input).

parameters.name: pv_efficiency
parameters.source: ends derived from sourced cell data (AZUR SPACE 3G30A-Advanced datasheet DB 00010892-01; JPL Pub. 78-15 Vol. VIII Table 7), mode assumed (PDF §5 example); configs/scenarios/*.yaml

parameters.name: pv_temperature_coefficient
parameters.source: low derived from JPL Pub. 78-15 Vol. VIII (K7 silicon), mode derived from the 3G30A datasheet dVmp/dT, dImp/dT, high = PDF §5 example (assumed)

parameters.name: weather_year
parameters.source: ERA5 hourly total cloud cover 2014-2023 at the site node (Hersbach et al. 2020, doi:10.1002/qj.3803; CDS doi:10.24381/1cf1ad76); each year equally likely (assumed)
